summary: CNL Strategic Capital filed an 8-K disclosing that on October 2, 2026 its wholly-owned subsidiary RE Strategic Capital EquityCo realized its roughly 7.8% indirect equity interest in Resolution Economics via a recapitalization, receiving approximately $29.2 million net cash after fees. The buyer was REG Investco, LLC, owned by an affiliate of Levine Leichtman Strategic Capital (the Sub-Manager) with ResEcon management and existing owners; the deal also repaid about $2.8 million of senior secured subordinated notes. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or close date was disclosed. Watch for proceeds redeployment and any valuation marks.
